title: Settings card: 2026 Yamaha YZ450F
ig_caption:
2026 Yamaha YZ450F. About 185 lb, intermediate, hardpack moto with ruts and square edges, stability and comfort the goals. This is the baseline Dialed built, next to the stock settings from the 2026 owner's service manual.

Stock sits at 12 and 9 on the fork, 8 clicks and 1 1/4 turns on the shock, 10 on shock rebound. Dialed moved rebound out on both ends, opened low-speed two clicks, went a quarter turn in on high-speed and set sag at 102 mm.

Starting points, not a law. Ride it, log how it felt, move one thing at a time, two clicks max.

Which bike, year and weight should I run next?
